children: Mundoro reported a Q3 2026 net loss of $269.8K, versus $412.4K in Q3 2025. It appointed Anil Jiwani CFO effective December 1, changed its auditor from PwC to Davidson, and will reduce its board from five directors to four effective December 31.
Material Details
Detail
AI Analyst View
Q3 net loss $269.8K vs. $412.4K in 2025
The loss narrowed year over year, though the release provides no outlook or explanation of the overall earnings trajectory.
Cash $2.96M vs. $5.22M at Dec. 31, 2025
Cash declined $2.25M over nine months; $1.53M comprises partner advances restricted to exploration.
Q3 fee income $287.0K vs. $246.6K in 2025
Higher operator fees supported year-over-year growth, but the release gives no full-year revenue outlook.
Anil Jiwani appointed CFO effective Dec. 1
A finance leadership change; services will be provided through an external firm, part of the stated fixed-cost restructuring.
Board to shrink from five directors to four
The change is intended to reduce governance costs; three of the four directors will be independent.
Auditor changes from PwC to Davidson
The company says the change followed a request-for-proposal process, not auditor resignation; it reported no modified opinions or reportable events.
Context by AI Analyst

This is a quarterly update alongside a corporate cost-structure review, rather than a new exploration-result disclosure. Evidence of sustained cost savings, partner funding and progress on drill-ready Serbian targets would be needed to make the changes a larger catalyst.
